result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major content/data rendering bug and one minor truncation issue.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid delivery price. NaN (Not a Number) is a JavaScript rendering error leaking into the UI.
issues.suggestion: Fix the data pipeline or frontend logic that calculates the delivery fee for this restaurant. Add a fallback value (e.g., '€0.00' or 'Free') when the delivery cost value is null, undefined, or cannot be parsed as a number.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off both visually and in its name text, with no affordance indicating the user can scroll horizontally.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the partially visible card provides a clear visual cue (e.g., a visible scroll indicator or shadow) to hint at horizontal scrollability, and confirm the restaurant name truncation uses an ellipsis properly to avoid abrupt cutoff.
